contentText:
Google shared a closeup of its upcoming fitness tracker. | Image: Google

It looks like Google is getting ready to take the wraps off its rumored Fitbit Edge next Monday. In a post on X , Google posted a picture of what appears to be the side of the fitness tracker, with the caption: "Get an Edge on your health. 10.12.26."

A trove of Fitbit Edge leaks has surfaced over the past couple of weeks. So far, details shared by Dealabs and Android Headlines suggest that the upcoming device could feature a 1.34-inch always-on OLED touchscreen , built-in GPS, and several other sensors, including an accelerometer, barometer, altimeter, and gyroscope.
